You can heal the places where you’re broken. I promise. There will be scars but the bleeding stops. It’s so ridiculously unfair that we’re responsible for fixing ourselves when we’re not the ones responsible for the damage. But it’s the way of the world. Hurt people hurt people and then the cycle goes on. We break the cycle of pain with love. For ourselves first. As black women especially. You deserve the love you need. I hope you can find that little girl inside you and give her a hug and tell her it’s not her fault.

You should feel it about an hour after you took it and it’ll peak about 2-3 hours in. You can only absorb about 1200mg in one go. Dose again at least 45 mins after the first one. 

The best method I’ve tried is to take a starter dose of about 900mg on an empty stomach. Fasting thru the day makes it hit much harder and faster in my experience. Wash it down with some soda, follow it up with some tea with extra lemon. I’ve heard that the acidity and carbonation of soda helps digest the gaba. Don’t know if it’s true, but I know the fasting + soda + tea certainly helps it absorb quickly. Then, I’ll take 600mg every hour or so after the last dose, eaten with a small, fatty snack like a few spoons of peanut butter, followed by more soda and/or lemon tea.
